title: phacelia stellaris
intro: Phacelia stellaris, commonly known as Starflower or Lacy Phacelia, is a perennial plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae) native to the Mediterranean region. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Phacelia stellaris are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Research suggests that Phacelia stellaris may also have neuroprotective and anti-cancer effects, although more studies are needed to confirm these findings.
